answer_1.quote: We conduct this task in an unsupervised environment ... that takes an input sentence x and a target style ŝ as inputs, and outputs a new sentence x̂ that is in the target style and retains the content information of x.
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences with the target style

answer_2.quote: We use two common datasets: Yelp and IMDB review. Style transfer accuracy (S-ACC) measures ... content preservation was evaluated with two BLEU scores, ... perplexity (PPL) ... BERT score ...

answer_4.quote: With each model, we randomly sample 150 outputs ... annotators are asked to evaluate the model generated sentence with a score range from 1 (Very Bad) to 5 (Very Good) on content preservation, style transfer accuracy, and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each generated sentence from 1 to 5 on content preservation, style transfer accuracy, and fluency.
